title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to invalidate cached WebSocket…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 contain a vulnerability where cached WebSocket session state is not invalidated when an OAuth app is deleted. This flaw allows a revoked OAuth integration to continue receiving real-time events, including private channel posts, through an already open WebSocket connection.
